Your eleven projects 69.0 with the armband on Haaland. The transfer is a free one and nets 6.4 points: Wood out for Watkins in, moving you from a 3-4-3 to a 3-5-2. You'll have £0.5m in the bank and no further moves to make.

Haaland leads Salah by 0.3 in projection and sits with a one-in-four chance of 10 or more. The armband call is marginal but defensible. Three Arsenal players and two each from Liverpool and Manchester City means your upside leans on those clubs' fixtures, though you know only what the projections tell you about that.

Your bench is empty, which you cannot change without a free transfer — that's spent on the Wood-Watkins swap. You'll need to field eleven and cannot cover for absences.

The transfer is a clear gain. Go with it.

Your side projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. The transfer of Wood to Watkins nets 6.4 points over the horizon with no hit cost, and the model backs it — Watkins is expected to outscore Wood by that margin across the gameweeks ahead. You have the free transfer to spend, so make it.

Arsenal dominate your outfield with three players, and Manchester City with two more besides Haaland. That concentration is worth watching as the season moves on, though there is nothing in this week's projection to suggest a problem. Salah is close enough to Haaland in expected points that the armband choice is genuinely tight; the gap is 0.3, and Haaland's ceiling (25% chance of 10+) is higher, but Salah's floor is floor is safer. The model's call stands either way.

You have no bench to speak of. Make sure your eleventh man will play.

Your team projects 69.0 with Haaland captained. The proposed transfer swaps Wood for Watkins at no cost to hits, gaining 6.4 points across the horizon and leaving you with £0.5m in the bank.

Haaland holds the armband by 0.3 over Salah, though either carries real variance—there is an 8% chance Haaland scores 2 or fewer despite the projection. The eleven is heavy on Arsenal and Manchester City; you have three at the former and two at each of the latter, balanced by two from Liverpool.

Watkins comes in as your third forward and replaces Wood at the bottom of the pecking order. The trade is costless and profitable on the model's horizon.

The bench is empty, so there is no depth behind the starting three attackers should any be unavailable.
